artworks.title: The Widow
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the upper torso up, positioned slightly turned to the right with her head tilted gently downward. Her eyes are closed, and she has delicate facial features with long hair partly covered by a dark head scarf or veil, with a light-colored band visible at her forehead. She is dressed in a dark, textured garment with a light-colored shirt underneath, and holds a cloth or handkerchief in her hands, which are placed near her chest. The background is an indistinct, softly textured surface.

artworks.title: Une boisson qui ne monte jamais à tête
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes related to drinking in Paris. The upper half of the drawing depicts two individuals sitting at a café table. On the left, a figure dressed in a suit is savoring a hot beverage, as indicated by the caption underneath. They are holding a cup to their lips, with an empty plate and a spoon in front of them. To the right, another figure, also well-dressed, is seated with a glass in hand. The background suggests a bustling café scene with more blurred silhouettes in the distance. In the lower half, a gentleman is drinking from a glass, while two figures stand nearby, one holding a jug and with a large barrel strapped to their back. The sketch illustrates the animated atmosphere of these Parisian scenes using lines and shadings.

artworks.title: Dans un cabinet de la maison d'or
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image consists of two sketches. In the upper sketch, three individuals are shown from the waist up around a table. Two are toasting with champagne glasses, while the third person also holds a glass. The first man has curly dark hair and a beard, the woman has styled curly hair, and the other man has his hair pulled back. They are dressed in formal attire. There are empty glasses and a bottle on the table. The background features a cozy, enclosed space with patterned wallpaper. In the lower sketch, an elderly man is depicted sitting in a chair with a blanket, wearing a nightcap. He holds a cup and is surrounded by a table with a teapot and a dish. The setting is simple, with minimalistic furniture.

artworks.title: Ce n'est pas sous l"empire qu'on aurait dansé comme ca! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking with a cane and linking arms with a woman. The man wears 19th-century formal attire including a top hat, tailcoat, waistcoat, and trousers. He has a moustache and prominent nose. The woman has a veil covering her face and wears a long gown with a shawl. The background depicts elegantly dressed people in a lively outdoor setting under large trees. The illustration is in a classic, newspaper-style with a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: L'Interieur d'un appartement trop garni...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room with multiple figures sleeping in various positions. The scene shows a cramped living space with individuals resting on makeshift beds like a hammock, a bench, and a mattress on the floor. The artwork displays detailed linear textures depicting the figures clothed in layers and blankets, along with furniture like a connecting wardrobe. Cross-hatching and shading are used to create depth and detail in the illustration.

artworks.title: Le printemps annonçant son retour à Paris
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The drawing shows two figures in Paris bracing against a strong wind. Their clothing is billowing dramatically and their garments are inflated by the gusts. An object is flying in the air. In the background, there are shapes suggesting trees and buildings. The drawing uses expressive lines to convey movement and the weather's impact.

artworks.title: Un loge au théâtre VENTADOUR...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four people in a box seat at the theater Ventadour. They are seated or leaning forward, observing the performance on stage. The individuals are captured from the waist up and appear to be dressed formally. One woman and three men are depicted, with the central figure having a bun hairstyle, and the men having short hair. A top hat is visible on a shelf in the box. The background shows an audience below and performers on stage as the focal point. The image has a sketch-like illustration style with cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: La planche démontree par le prècepte ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three people in a scene that appears to be in an indoor setting resembling a bathhouse or pool area. Two individuals are standing in the foreground while a third person is seated on a bench in the background.

artworks.title: Oui c'est bien feue ma femme! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures observing a framed piece of art. The scene presents an interior setting where one figure is seated, looking at a painting on an easel, while another figure stands nearby. The tonal shades are achieved through hatching, creating depth in the room. The figures are drawn in an expressive style, conveying contemplation. The framed artwork on the wall in the background adds context to the scene.

artworks.title: Dites donc, not'maire ... des communistes qué qu'c'est ça?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men engaged in conversation near some ruins. The drawing highlights a rural setting where one man is seen leaning on a stone structure while conversing with another who appears to be addressing the first. The clothing of the individuals suggests different societal roles, with the larger figure in a full suit and the smaller figure in casual workwear. In the background, trees and a building are depicted, suggesting a countryside atmosphere. Text is present at the bottom of the drawing, adding context to the scene above.

artworks.title: Actionnaires de chemins de fer causant dividendes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are standing on a cobblestone street facing each other. The man on the left wears a hat, a striped suit, and his hands are in his pockets. The man on the right wears a top hat, a dark jacket, and has his hands resting near his pockets. The background features tall buildings with some architectural details.

artworks.title: Quant a moi je tiens a employer ... la force du raisonnement
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a conversation between two men with a child standing between them. The image shows the interaction of two adult figures, one standing with hands clasped and the other with hands on their hips, while a child stands in the foreground holding onto their coattails. The figures are positioned indoors, possibly in a dimly lit room with simple decor. Behind them, in the background, there are three smaller figures sitting closely together. The style is characterized by detailed line work and shading, creating a sense of depth and texture in the clothing and surroundings. The posture and expressions of the figures suggest a narrative or comedic exchange.

artworks.title: Disciples de M. Cobden
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of two exaggerated characters interacting chaotically with animals. One figure is handling small creatures, possibly rats, while the other appears to be alarmed and holding a broom. There is a larger creature nearby. The background features simple buildings, and the title at the top reads "SOUVENIRS DU CONGRÈS DE LA PAIX." The drawing conveys a sense of humor through the exaggerated actions and expressions.

artworks.title: Le jour ou ... Théobald a appris son dégommage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures in political situations. The drawing includes two scenes. The top scene features three exaggerated figures, one appearing sad, while the others look on. The setting resembles a stage with additional figures in the background. The bottom scene depicts two figures with large helmets or hats in military or ceremonial poses, riding small creatures in the rain with umbrellas in the background. The style is satirical and exaggerated, typical for caricature drawings that critique or make light of political or social scenarios.

artworks.title: Pierre Leroux Osant apostrophe ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parliamentary scene depicted in a satirical manner. The image consists of two panels; the upper panel shows a figure leaning aggressively over a podium as if addressing someone seated below. The figure seated below is depicted with a stern facial expression, with "MINISTRES" written behind. The lower panel portrays the same individual engaging with others, receiving handshakes from those surrounding him, who are depicted with exaggerated facial features typical of caricature. The assembly setting includes an audience of similarly exaggerated characters seated in rows. This drawing is likely a humorous social or political commentary through its caricature style.

artworks.title: Monsieur le sténographe ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a political assembly setting with exaggerated caricatures. There are two main scenes depicted: one with a man handing a document to another seated man, and the other with a man bending forward toward a smaller man. The art style uses exaggeration to convey the actions and energies in the scenes, highlighting the political nature. The text accompanying the images provides additional context for the interactions.

artworks.title: Vue de M. Dupin se rendant a l'assemblée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricatured assembly scene. The image is split into two sections with exaggerated figures engaging in political activities. In the upper section, a prominent figure walks confidently past a line of uniformed guards. The guards have humorous facial expressions, and one plays a drum. In the lower section, a discussion or speech takes place in an assembly setting. The audience comprises six exaggeratedly caricatured figures seated in a gallery, observing a speaker at a podium who gestures expressively while addressing a gathering of people in the background. The artwork appears to portray a satirical take on political or governmental procedures.

artworks.title: VOILLLLLLLLLLLA LE GRRRRRRRRRRRRRRAND galop charivarique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a satirical print with a dense crowd and text block at the center. The illustration includes a crowded scene with people rushing around a central text space. Musicians play instruments in the upper section, while people in victorian attire, including top hats, populate the lower area. The text "VOILLLLLLLLA LE GRRRRRRRRRRGRAND GALOP CHARIVARIQUE" suggests a satirical tone. The crowd appears lively, energetic, and chaotic, with exaggerated expressions and movements. The central text likely provides context for the scene.

artworks.title: M. Dupin dans ses petits souliers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricature scene. The drawing depicts a figure with exaggerated features carrying a bundle on a stick, descending stairs in a courtroom or legislative setting. The figure wears oversized shoes and has elongated limbs. The background shows a blurred audience with individuals seated in balconies. A large wooden chair is placed to the right. The scene humorously satirizes the character and situation.

artworks.title: Un cauchemar de Mimi
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and segmented shapes forming an abstract scene with a syringe-like object with legs at the center. A small cartoon-like figure holds onto the syringe with a mischievous expression to the left. Above, a spider-like creature has a round object as a body with text written on it. In the background, flowing lines suggest drapery, creating the impression of a bedroom scene with a figure partially hidden under bedclothes on the right.

artworks.title: Divertissement qui devrait être interdit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatured figures ice skating. A man is depicted sitting on the ground with a defeated expression, beside a fallen top hat. Two other figures skate with exaggerated postures, wearing coats and tall hats. In the background, a crowd of onlookers appear to be enjoying the spectacle. The tone of the drawing is humorous, emphasizing the clumsiness of the figures.

artworks.title: Vous verrez ... rien n'échappera a la baisse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing outdoors on a cobblestone surface. The man on the left is leaning towards the man on the right. He is wearing a coat, pants, and top hat, with facial features obscured. The man on the right faces forward with a surprised expression, holding a walking cane. He is dressed in a coat and top hat. The background includes outlines of buildings in an urban cityscape.

artworks.title: Un alibi
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three men in 19th-century attire are conversing in the drawing. Their expressions indicate a lively discussion. One man gestures towards another. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatched shading. A French caption below seems to reference an alibi.

artworks.title: Tout ce qu'on voudra
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of sculptures being observed by a group of individuals in formal attire. The drawing features a collection of classical sculptures on a platform in the background. In the foreground, a group of individuals dressed in 19th-century clothing are seen observing the sculptures. The individuals appear to be somewhat surprised or bemused by the sculptures. Some of them are depicted in profile view, and they seem to be discussing or evaluating the artworks. The drawing uses shading and line work to create depth and expression, capturing a moment of interaction between art and observers.
